newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius share index down as leading stocks fall.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius share index down as leading stocks fall.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius share index, Semdex, fell by 4.09 points on Wednesday to 370.40 amid declines in leading stocks, brokers said.
Turnover was posted at 5.49 million rupees on 181,221 shares from 10.84 million rupees on 179,128 shares on Monday.
"Foreign investors are not showing buying intention and are now keeping away from the stock market," one broker said.

In the tourism sector, Sun Resorts lost 1.70 rupee to 46.00 rupees on 38,999 shares, Grand Baie Hotel (GBH) fell 1.00 rupee to 51.00 rupees on 12,200 shares and New Mauritius Hotels (NMH) eased 10 cents to 37.90 rupees, but was not quoted.
State Bank of Mauritius (SBM) lost 30 cents to 12.00 rupees on 36,500 shares and Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB) was stable at 87.50 rupees on 15,000 shares.

"Fundamentally the listed stocks are healthy and sound. We are expecting most of them, particularly those from the banking and hotel sectors to post above average earnings by the end of the year," another broker said.

Sugar based Harel Freres was 1.50 rupee lower to 51.50 rupees on 40 shares and Mon Desert Alma (MDA) (O) was unchanged to 75.00 rupees on 50 shares. In the commerce sector, Ireland Blyth Ltd (IBL) eased 40 cents to 15.00 rupees on 8,350 shares and Rogers edged 50 cents to 91.00 rupees on 5 shares.
Investment stocks National Investment Trust (NIT) fell 30 cents to 10.20 rupees on 8,000 shares and United Docks was stable at 36.00 rupees on 500 shares.
Air Mauritius fell 10 cents to 35.30 rupees on 1,100 shares.
